From Fsub.FuncColour Require Import Fsub_LetSum_Definitions.

Theorem preservation : forall E s s',
  typing_state E s ->
  s --> s' ->
  typing_state E s'.

Theorem progress : forall s,
  typing_state empty s ->
  done_state s \/ exists s', s --> s'.

42	  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp

77	Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
78	  match q with
79	  | qua_top => Some cqua_top
80	  | qua_fvar X => None
81	  | qua_bvar n => None
82	  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>

84	    | Some cqua_top => Some cqua_top
85	    | Some cqua_bot => (concretize Q2)
86	    | None => None
87	    end
88	  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
89	    match (concretize Q1) with
90	    | Some cqua_top => (concretize Q2)
91	    | Some cqua_bot => Some cqua_bot
92	    | None => None
93	    end
94	  | qua_bot => Some cqua_bot
95	  end.

100	  | cqua_bot => qua_bot
101	  end.

103	Inductive cqua_compatible : concrete_qua -> concrete_qua -> Prop :=
104	  | cqua_compatible_same : forall s, cqua_compatible s s
105	  | cqua_compatible_up : cqua_compatible cqua_bot cqua_top.

107	Notation "s ≤ t" := (cqua_compatible s t) (at level 70).

109	Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=

111	  | qua_top => qua_top
112	  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)

114	  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)

117	  end.

121	  | typ_top => typ_top

123	  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
124	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)

130	  end

132	  match T with

169	  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_te_rec K U e1)
170	  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_te_rec K U e2)
171	  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_te_rec K U e1)
172	  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
173	  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_te_rec K U e1)
174	  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.FuncColour.LabelMap.

Require Export Fsub.FuncColour.Label.

Require Export Fsub.FqMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive qua : Set :=
  | qua_top : qua
  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua
  | qua_fvar : atom -> qua
  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_bot : qua
.

Notation "`async" := qua_top.

Notation "`sync" := qua_bot.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
with qtyp : Set :=
  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_first : exp -> exp
  | exp_second : exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref_label : qua -> label -> exp
  | exp_deref : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_ref : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_upqual : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_check : qua -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Coercion qua_bvar : nat >-> qua.

Coercion qua_fvar : atom >-> qua.

Inductive concrete_qua : Set := cqua_top | cqua_bot.

Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
  match q with
  | qua_top => Some cqua_top
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => Some cqua_top
    | Some cqua_bot => (concretize Q2)
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => (concretize Q2)
    | Some cqua_bot => Some cqua_bot
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_bot => Some cqua_bot
  end.

Definition abstractize (s : concrete_qua) :=
  match s with
  | cqua_top => qua_top
  | cqua_bot => qua_bot
  end.

Inductive cqua_compatible : concrete_qua -> concrete_qua -> Prop :=
  | cqua_compatible_same : forall s, cqua_compatible s s
  | cqua_compatible_up : cqua_compatible cqua_bot cqua_top.

Notation "s ≤ t" := (cqua_compatible s t) (at level 70).

Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_top => qua_top
  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)
  | qua_fvar X => qua_fvar X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_bot => qua_bot
  end.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end
with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_qt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_qqt_rec K R T1)
  end
with open_qqt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qt_rec K R T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (open_tqt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_te_rec K U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2) (open_te_rec (S K) U e3)
  | exp_pair R e1 e2 => exp_pair R (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_te_rec K U e1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qe_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qqt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qt_rec K R V)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qt_rec K R V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qq_rec K R Q)  (open_qe_rec (S K) R e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qq_rec K R Q)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e2) (open_qe_rec (S K) R e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (open_qq_rec K R P) l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_qe_rec K R e1) (open_qe_rec K R e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (open_qq_rec K R P) (open_qe_rec K R e1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_inr P e2 => exp_inr P (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (open_ee_rec k f e1)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
               (open_ee_rec (S k) f e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_second e2 => exp_second (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Definition open_qq Q R := open_qq_rec 0 R Q.

Definition open_qe e R := open_qe_rec 0 R e.

Definition open_qt T R := open_qt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_qqt T R := open_qqt_rec 0 R T.

Definition open_tqt T R := open_tqt_rec 0 R T.

Inductive qual : qua -> Prop :=
  | qual_top :
      qual qua_top
  | qual_fvar : forall (X : atom),
      qual (qua_fvar X)
  | qual_meet : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | qual_join : forall Q1 Q2,
      qual Q1 ->
      qual Q2 ->
      qual (qua_join Q1 Q2)
  | qual_bot :
      qual qua_bot
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_qall : forall L Q T,
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> qtype (open_qqt T X)) ->
      type (typ_qall Q T)
  | type_sum : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | type_pair : forall T1 T2,
      qtype T1 ->
      qtype T2 ->
      type (typ_pair T1 T2)
with qtype : qtyp -> Prop :=
  | qtype_qtyp : forall Q T,
      qual Q ->
      type T ->
      qtype (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      qtype T ->
      qual P ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs P T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L P T e1,
      qual P ->
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs P T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_qabs : forall L P Q e1,
      qual P ->
      qual Q ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_qe e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_qabs P Q e1)
  | expr_qapp : forall e1 Q,
      expr e1 ->
      qual Q ->
      expr (exp_qapp e1 Q)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_inl : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inl P e1)
  | expr_inr : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_inr P e1)
  | expr_case : forall L e1 e2 e3,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e3 x)) ->
      expr (exp_case e1 e2 e3)
  | expr_pair : forall P e1 e2,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_pair P e1 e2)
  | expr_first : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_first e1)
  | expr_second : forall e1,
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_second e1)
  | expr_upqual : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_upqual P e1)
  | expr_check : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      expr e1 ->
      expr (exp_check P e1)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : qtyp -> binding
  | bind_qua : qua -> binding.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive wf_qua : env -> qua -> Prop :=
  | wf_qua_top : forall E,
      wf_qua E qua_top
  | wf_qua_fvar : forall R E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X)
  | wf_qua_meet : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_meet Q1 Q2)
  | wf_qua_join : forall E Q1 Q2,
      wf_qua E Q1 ->
      wf_qua E Q2 ->
      wf_qua E (qua_join Q1 Q2)
  | wf_qua_bot : forall E,
      wf_qua E qua_bot
.

Notation "E |-q Q wf" := (wf_qua E Q) (at level 70).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_qall : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_qua E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_qall T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_sum : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_pair : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_pair T1 T2)
with wf_qtyp : env -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | wf_qtyp_qtyp : forall E Q T,
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_qtyp E (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Notation "E |-t T wf" := (wf_typ E T) (at level 70).

Notation "E |-qt T wf" := (wf_qtyp E T) (at level 70).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : qtyp),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qtyp E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E)
  | wf_env_qua : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (Q : qua),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E)
.

Notation "|- E wf" := (wf_env E) (at level 70).

Inductive subqual : env -> qua -> qua -> Prop :=
  | subqual_top : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E Q qua_top
  | subqual_bot : forall E Q,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      subqual E qua_bot Q
  | subqual_refl_qvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E (qua_fvar X) ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) (qua_fvar X)
  | subqual_trans_qvar : forall R E Q X,
      binds X (bind_qua R) E ->
      subqual E R Q ->
      subqual E (qua_fvar X) Q
  | subqual_join_inl : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_inr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_join R1 R2)
  | subqual_join_elim : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_join R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_eliml : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E R1 Q ->
      wf_qua E R2 ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_elimr : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      wf_qua E R1 ->
      subqual E R2 Q ->
      subqual E (qua_meet R1 R2) Q
  | subqual_meet_intro : forall E R1 R2 Q,
      subqual E Q R1 ->
      subqual E Q R2 ->
      subqual E Q (qua_meet R1 R2)
.

Notation "E |-sq Q1 <: Q2" := (subqual E Q1 Q2) (at level 70).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E T1 S1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          subqtype (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt S2 X) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_qall : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqual E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          subqtype (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E) (open_qqt S2 X) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_qall S1 S2) (typ_qall T1 T2)
  | sub_sum : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E S1 T1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_sum S1 S2) (typ_sum T1 T2)
  | sub_pair : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      subqtype E S1 T1 ->
      subqtype E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_pair S1 S2) (typ_pair T1 T2)
with subqtype : env -> qtyp -> qtyp -> Prop :=
  | sub_qtyp_qtyp : forall E Q1 T1 Q2 T2,
      subqual E Q1 Q2 ->
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      subqtype E (qtyp_qtyp Q1 T1) (qtyp_qtyp Q2 T2)
.

Notation "E |-t S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Notation "E |-sqt S <: T" := (subqtype E S T) (at level 70).

Inductive typing : env -> qua -> exp -> qtyp -> Prop :=

  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E qua_bot (exp_fvar x) T

  | typing_abs : forall L E P V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) P (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E qua_bot (exp_abs P V e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_arrow V T1))

  | typing_app : forall Q T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q e2 T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_app e1 e2) T2

  | typing_tabs : forall L E P V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) P (open_te e1 X) (open_tqt T1 X)) ->
      typing E qua_bot (exp_tabs P V e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_all V T1))

  | typing_tapp : forall Q T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_all T1 T2)) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tqt T2 T)

  | typing_qabs : forall L E P Q e1 T1,
      wf_qua E P ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_qua Q ++ E) P (open_qe e1 X) (open_qqt T1 X)) ->
      typing E qua_bot (exp_qabs P Q e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_qall Q T1))

  | typing_qapp : forall Q E e1 Q1 T,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_qall Q1 T)) ->
      subqual E Q Q1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_qapp e1 Q) (open_qqt T Q)

  | typing_sub : forall S E Q e T,
      typing E Q e S ->
      subqtype E S T ->
      typing E Q e T

  | typing_subqual : forall E Q R e T,
      typing E Q e T ->
      subqual E Q R ->
      typing E R e T

  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E Q,
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E Q (exp_let e1 e2) T2


  | typing_inl : forall T1 T2 P e1 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      typing E Q (exp_inl P e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2))
  | typing_inr : forall T1 T2 P e1 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T2 ->
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      typing E Q (exp_inr P e1) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2))
  | typing_case : forall L T1 T2 P T e1 e2 e3 E Q,
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T2 ++ E) Q (open_ee e3 x) T) ->
      typing E Q (exp_case e1 e2 e3) T
  | typing_pair : forall T1 T2 P e1 e2 E Q,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      typing E Q e2 T2 ->
      typing E Q (exp_pair P e1 e2) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2))
  | typing_first : forall Q T1 T2 P e E,
      typing E Q e (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q (exp_first e) T1
  | typing_second : forall Q T1 T2 P e E,
      typing E Q e (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q (exp_second e) T2
  | typing_upqual : forall E R Q T P e,
      typing E R e (qtyp_qtyp Q T) ->
      subqual E Q P ->
      typing E R (exp_upqual P e) (qtyp_qtyp P T)
  | typing_check : forall E R Q T P e,
      typing E R e (qtyp_qtyp Q T) ->
      subqual E Q P ->
      typing E R (exp_check P e) (qtyp_qtyp Q T)
.

Notation "E @ Q |-t e : T" := (typing E Q e T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall P T e1,
      expr (exp_abs P T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs P T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall P T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs P T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs P T e1)
 | value_qabs : forall P Q e1,
      expr (exp_qabs P Q e1) ->
      value (exp_qabs P Q e1)
  | value_inl : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value (exp_inl P e1)
  | value_inr : forall P e1,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value (exp_inr P e1)
  | value_pair : forall P e1 e2,
      qual P ->
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      value (exp_pair P e1 e2)
.

Inductive frame : Set :=

  | frame_abs (e : exp) : frame

  | frame_app (f : exp) : frame

  | frame_tabs (T : typ) : frame

  | frame_qabs (R : qua) : frame

  | frame_let (e : exp) : frame

  | frame_inl (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_inr (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_case (e1 : exp) (e2 : exp) : frame

  | frame_pair_1 (P : qua) (e1 : exp) : frame

  | frame_pair_2 (P : qua) (e2 : exp) : frame

  | frame_first : frame

  | frame_second : frame

  | frame_upqual (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_check (P : qua) : frame

  | frame_barrier : concrete_qua -> frame.

Notation ctx := (list frame).

Notation done := (@nil frame).

Inductive typing_ctx : env -> qua -> ctx -> qtyp -> Prop :=

  | typing_ctx_done : forall E Q T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_qua E Q ->
      wf_qtyp E T ->
      typing_ctx E Q done T

  | typing_ctx_abs : forall E Q c e1 T1 T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 ->
      typing E Q e1 T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_abs e1 :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2))

  | typing_ctx_app : forall E Q c e1 T1 T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 ->
      value e1 ->
      typing E Q e1 (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_arrow T1 T2)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_app e1 :: c) T1

  | typing_ctx_tabs : forall L E Q c T1 T1' T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c (open_tqt T2 T1') ->
      sub E T1' T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tqt T2 X)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_tabs T1' :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_all T1 T2))
  | typing_ctx_qabs : forall L E Q c R R' T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c (open_qqt T2 R') ->
      subqual E R' R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          wf_qtyp (X ~ bind_qua R ++ E) (open_qqt T2 X)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_qabs R' :: c) (qtyp_qtyp Q (typ_qall R T2))

  | typing_ctx_let : forall L E Q c e1 T1 T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 ->
      (forall x, x `notin` L -> typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e1 x) T2) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_let e1 :: c) T1

  | typing_ctx_inl : forall E P Q c T1 T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_inl P :: c) T1
  | typing_ctx_inr : forall E P Q c T1 T2,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2)) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_inr P :: c) T2

  | typing_ctx_case : forall L E P Q c T T1 T2 e2 e3,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) Q (open_ee e2 x) T) ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T2 ++ E) Q (open_ee e3 x) T) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_case e2 e3 :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_sum T1 T2))

  | typing_ctx_pair_1 : forall E P Q c e T1 T2,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      typing E Q e T2 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_pair_1 P e :: c) T1
  | typing_ctx_pair_2 : forall E P Q c v T1 T2,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2)) ->
      value v ->
      typing E Q v T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_pair_2 P v :: c) T2

  | typing_ctx_first : forall E P Q c T1 T2,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T1 ->
      wf_qtyp E T2 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_first :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2))
  | typing_ctx_second : forall E P Q c T1 T2,
      wf_qua E P ->
      typing_ctx E Q c T2 ->
      wf_qtyp E T1 ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_second :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P (typ_pair T1 T2))

  | typing_ctx_barrier : forall E Q c s t T,
      typing_ctx E Q c T ->
      (concretize Q) = Some s ->
      t ≤ s ->
      typing_ctx E (abstractize t) (frame_barrier t :: c) T

  | typing_ctx_upqual : forall E Q c P T,
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P T) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_upqual P :: c) (qtyp_qtyp P T)
  | typing_ctx_check :  forall E Q c R P T,
      wf_qua E R ->
      typing_ctx E Q c (qtyp_qtyp P T) ->
      typing_ctx E Q (frame_check R :: c) (qtyp_qtyp (qua_meet P R) T)

  | typing_ctx_sub : forall E Q c S T,
      typing_ctx E Q c T ->
      subqtype E S T ->
      typing_ctx E Q c S
  | typing_ctx_subqual : forall E Q R c T,
      typing_ctx E Q c T ->
      subqual E R Q ->
      typing_ctx E R c T
.

Notation "E @ Q |-c c : T ~≤ ⊥" := (typing_ctx E Q c T) (at level 70).

Inductive state : Type :=
  | state_step (e : exp) (c : ctx) : state.

Notation "〈 e | c 〉" := (state_step e c).

Inductive typing_state : env -> state -> Prop :=
  | typing_step : forall E Q e c T,
    typing E Q e T ->
    typing_ctx E Q c T ->
    typing_state E〈 e | c 〉
.

Inductive barrier_compatible : ctx -> concrete_qua -> Prop :=
  | barrier_compatible_done : forall s, barrier_compatible done s
  | barrier_compatible_frame : forall c s t,
      barrier_compatible c s ->
      s ≤ t ->
      barrier_compatible (frame_barrier t :: c) s
  | barrier_compatible_other : forall c s f,
      barrier_compatible c s ->
      (forall t, f <> frame_barrier t) ->
      barrier_compatible (f :: c) s
.

Inductive step : state -> state -> Prop :=

  | step_barrier : forall e s k,
      value e ->
      step〈 e | frame_barrier s :: k 〉〈 e | k 〉

  | step_app_1 : forall e1 e2 k,
      step〈 (exp_app e1 e2) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_abs e2 :: k 〉
  | step_app_2 : forall v e2 k,
      value v ->
      step〈 v | frame_abs e2 :: k 〉
        〈 e2 | frame_app v :: k 〉
  | step_tapp : forall e1 T k,
      step〈 (exp_tapp e1 T) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_tabs T :: k 〉
  | step_qapp : forall e1 Q k,
      step〈 (exp_qapp e1 Q) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_qabs Q :: k 〉
  | step_let : forall e1 e2 k,
      step〈 (exp_let e1 e2) | k 〉
        〈 e1 | frame_let e2 :: k 〉
  | step_inl : forall e1 P k,

From Fsub.FuncColour Require Import Fsub_LetSum_Definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Program.Equality.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Free atoms                                                            *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint fv_qq (Q : qua) : atoms :=
  match Q with
  | qua_top => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | qua_bot => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | qua_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | qua_fvar X => singleton X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qq Q1) (fv_qq Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qq Q1) (fv_qq Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => AtomSetImpl.empty
...
  - (* meet_eliml *)
    apply subqual_meet_eliml; [apply (IHsubqual X Hwf eq_refl R0 Hb S H2) | exact H].
  - (* meet_elimr *)
    apply subqual_meet_elimr; [exact H | apply (IHsubqual X Hwf eq_refl R0 Hb S H2)].
Qed.

156	  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => exp_case (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2) (subst_te X U e3)
157	  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
158	  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_te X U e1)
159	  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_te X U e1)
160	  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (subst_te X U e1)
161	  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
162	  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_te X U e1)
163	  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_te X U e1) (subst_te X U e2)
164	  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (subst_te X U e1)
165	  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (subst_te X U e1)
166	  end.

168	Fixpoint subst_qe (X : atom) (R : qua) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
169	  match e with
170	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
171	  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
172	  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qqt X R V) (subst_qe X R e1)
173	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
174	  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qt X R V) (subst_qe X R e1)
175	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qt X R V)
176	  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qq X R Q) (subst_qe X R e1)
177	  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qq X R Q)
178	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
179	  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
180	  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
181	  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 => exp_case (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2) (subst_qe X R e3)
182	  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
183	  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (subst_qe X R e1)
184	  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (subst_qe X R e1)
185	  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
186	  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label (subst_qq X R P) l
187	  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (subst_qe X R e1)
188	  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (subst_qe X R e1) (subst_qe X R e2)
189	  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
190	  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check (subst_qq X R P) (subst_qe X R e1)
191	  end.

193	Definition subst_bind_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
194	  match b with
195	  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt X U T)
196	  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tqt X U T)
197	  | bind_qua Q => bind_qua Q
198	  end.
199	
200	Definition subst_env_te (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) : env :=
201	  map (subst_bind_te X U) E.
202	
203	Definition subst_bind_qe (X : atom) (R : qua) (b : binding) : binding :=
204	  match b with
205	  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_qt X R T)
206	  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_qqt X R T)
207	  | bind_qua Q => bind_qua (subst_qq X R Q)
208	  end.
209	
210	Definition subst_env_qe (X : atom) (R : qua) (E : env) : env :=
211	  map (subst_bind_qe X R) E.

404	Lemma wf_qua_weaken : forall E E' Q,
405	  wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
406	Proof.
407	  intros E E' Q Hwf Hext Hq.
408	  induction Hq as [E0|R E0 X Hb|E0 Q1 Q2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|E0 Q1 Q2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2|E0].
409	  - apply wf_qua_top.
410	  - apply wf_qua_fvar with (R := R). apply Hext. exact Hb.
411	  - apply wf_qua_meet.
412	    + apply IH1. exact Hext.
413	    + apply IH2. exact Hext.
414	  - apply wf_qua_join.
415	    + apply IH1. exact Hext.
416	    + apply IH2. exact Hext.
417	  - apply wf_qua_bot.
418	Qed.

420	Lemma wf_typ_weaken : forall E E' T,
421	  wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E' T.
422	Proof.
423	  intros E E' T Hwf Hext Hwt.
424	  revert E' Hwf Hext.
425	  induction Hwt using wf_typ_mut_ind
426	    with (P := fun E T w => forall E' : env, wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
427	         (P0 := fun E T w => forall E' : env, wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
428	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_top.
429	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_var with (U := U). apply Hext0. assumption.
430	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_arrow.
431	    * apply IHHwt; assumption.
432	    * apply IHHwt0; assumption.
433	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_all with (L := union L (dom E0)).
434	    * apply IHHwt; assumption.
435	    * intros X Hx.
436	      assert (HxL : X `notin` L) by fsetdec.
437	      assert (Hxd : X `notin` dom E0) by fsetdec.
438	      apply (H X HxL (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0)).
439	      -- apply wf_env_sub with (X := X) (T := T1).
440	         ++ exact Hwf0.
441	         ++ apply IHHwt; assumption.
442	         ++ exact Hxd.
443	      -- apply env_extends_cons; assumption.
444	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_qall with (L := union L (dom E0)).
445	    * apply (wf_qua_weaken E E0 T1 Hwf0 Hext0 w).
446	    * intros X Hx.
447	      assert (HxL : X `notin` L) by fsetdec.
448	      assert (Hxd : X `notin` dom E0) by fsetdec.
449	      apply (H X HxL (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E0)).
450	      -- apply wf_env_qua with (X := X) (Q := T1).
451	         ++ exact Hwf0.
452	         ++ apply (wf_qua_weaken E E0 T1 Hwf0 Hext0 w).
453	         ++ exact Hxd.
454	      -- apply env_extends_cons; assumption.
455	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_sum.
456	    * apply IHHwt; assumption.
457	    * apply IHHwt0; assumption.
458	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_typ_pair.
459	    * apply IHHwt; assumption.
460	    * apply IHHwt0; assumption.
461	  + intros E0 Hwf0 Hext0. apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
462	    * apply (wf_qua_weaken E E0 Q Hwf0 Hext0 w).
463	    * apply IHHwt; assumption.
464	Qed.

466	Lemma wf_qtyp_weaken : forall E E' T,
467	  wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E T -> wf_qtyp E' T.

469	  intros E E' T Hwf Hext Hwt. destruct T as [Q T]. inversion Hwt; subst.
470	  apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
471	  - apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption.
472	  - apply wf_typ_weaken with (E := E); assumption.
473	Qed.

481	Lemma wf_binding_weaken : forall E E' (b : binding),
482	  wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' ->
483	  (match b with
484	   | bind_sub T => wf_typ E T
485	   | bind_typ T => wf_qtyp E T
486	   | bind_qua Q => wf_qua E Q
487	   end) ->
488	  (match b with
489	   | bind_sub T => wf_typ E' T
490	   | bind_typ T => wf_qtyp E' T
491	   | bind_qua Q => wf_qua E' Q
492	   end).
493	Proof.
494	  intros E E' b Hwf Hext. destruct b; simpl; intros H;

496	  | apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E)]; assumption.

499	Lemma wf_env_binds_wf : forall E, wf_env E -> forall (x : atom) (b : binding),
500	  binds x b E ->
501	  match b with
502	  | bind_sub T => wf_typ E T
503	  | bind_typ T => wf_qtyp E T
504	  | bind_qua Q => wf_qua E Q
505	  end.
506	Proof.
507	  intros E Hwf. induction Hwf; intros y b Hb.
508	  - destruct Hb.
509	  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
510	    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl.
511	      apply wf_typ_weaken with (E := E).
512	      * apply wf_env_sub; assumption.
513	      * apply env_extends_cons_tail.
514	      * assumption.
515	    + apply IHHwf in Hin. destruct b; simpl in *.
516	      * apply wf_typ_weaken with (E := E); auto.
517	        apply wf_env_sub; assumption.
518	        apply env_extends_cons_tail.
519	      * apply wf_qtyp_weaken with (E := E); auto.
520	        apply wf_env_sub; assumption.
521	        apply env_extends_cons_tail.
522	      * apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); auto.
523	        apply wf_env_sub; assumption.
524	        apply env_extends_cons_tail.
525	  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
526	    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl.
527	      apply wf_qtyp_weaken with (E := E).
528	      * apply wf_env_typ; assumption.
529	      * apply env_extends_cons_tail.
530	      * assumption.
531	    + apply IHHwf in Hin. destruct b; simpl in *.

Fixpoint fv_qq (Q : qua) : atoms :=
  match Q with

  | qua_bot => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | qua_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | qua_fvar X => singleton X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qq Q1) (fv_qq Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => union (fv_qq Q1) (fv_qq Q2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | typ_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | typ_fvar X => singleton X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => union (fv_tqt T1) (fv_tqt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => union (fv_tt T1) (fv_tqt T2)

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Environment kind-equivalence and wf invariance                        *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Inductive binding_kind : binding -> Prop :=
  | kind_sub : forall T, binding_kind (bind_sub T)
  | kind_typ : forall T, binding_kind (bind_typ T)
  | kind_qua : forall Q, binding_kind (bind_qua Q).

Definition env_kind_eq (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  (forall x b, binds x b E -> exists b', binds x b' E' /\ binding_kind b /\ binding_kind b') /\
  (forall x b, binds x b E' -> exists b, binds x b E /\ binding_kind b /\ binding_kind b').

Lemma env_kind_eq_cons : forall E E' x b b',
  env_kind_eq E E' -> binding_kind b -> binding_kind b' ->
  env_kind_eq ((x,b) :: E) ((x,b') :: E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b b' [H1 H2] Kb Kb'. split.
  - intros y c Hyc. simpl in Hyc. destruct Hyc as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists b'. split; [left; reflexivity | split; assumption].
    + destruct (H1 y c Hin) as [c' [Hin' [Kc Kc']]].
      exists c'. split; [right; assumption | split; assumption].
  - intros y c Hyc. simpl in Hyc. destruct Hyc as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists b. split; [left; reflexivity | split; assumption].
    + destruct (H2 y c Hin) as [c' [Hin' [Kc' Kc]]].
      exists c'. split; [right; assumption | split; assumption].
Qed.

Lemma wf_qua_kind_eq : forall E E' Q,
  env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E E' Q [H1 H2] H. induction H.
  - apply wf_qua_top.
  - apply wf_qua_fvar. destruct (H1 X (bind_qua R) H) as [b' [Hb' [_ Kb']]].
    inversion Kb'; subst. assumption.
  - apply wf_qua_meet; assumption.
  - apply wf_qua_join; assumption.
  - apply wf_qua_bot.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_kind_eq : forall E E' T,
  env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_typ E T -> wf_typ E' T
with wf_qtyp_kind_eq : forall E E' T,
  env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qtyp E T -> wf_qtyp E' T.
Proof.
  - intros E E' T Hk H. induction H using wf_typ_mut_ind
      with (P := fun E T w => forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
           (P0 := fun E T w => forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_top.
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_var with (U := U).
      destruct Hk' as [H1 H2]. destruct (H1 X (bind_sub U) b) as [b' [Hb' [_ Kb']]].
      inversion Kb'; subst. assumption.
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_arrow.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp; assumption.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp0; assumption.
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
      * intros X Hx. apply (H0 X Hx E').
        apply env_kind_eq_cons; [assumption | apply kind_sub | apply kind_sub].
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_qall with (L := L).
      * apply wf_qua_kind_eq; assumption.
      * intros X Hx. apply (H0 X Hx E').
        apply env_kind_eq_cons; [assumption | apply kind_qua | apply kind_qua].
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_sum.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp; assumption.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp0; assumption.
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_typ_pair.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp; assumption.
      * apply IHwf_qtyp0; assumption.
    + intros E' Hk'. apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
      * apply wf_qua_kind_eq; assumption.
      * apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
  - intros E E' T Hk H. destruct T as [Q T]. inversion H; subst.
    apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
    + apply wf_qua_kind_eq; assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_kind_eq; assumption.
Qed.
EOF

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Environment morphisms ignoring term-variable bindings                 *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition env_subqua_extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  (forall (X : atom) (U : typ), binds X (bind_sub U) E -> binds X (bind_sub U) E') /\
  (forall (X : atom) (Q : qua), binds X (bind_qua Q) E -> binds X (bind_qua Q) E').

Lemma env_subqua_extends_cons : forall E E' (y : atom) (b : binding),
  env_subqua_extends E E' ->
  env_subqua_extends (y ~ b ++ E) (y ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' y b [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
  - intros X U HX. destruct HX as [Heq|Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right; apply H1; assumption.
  - intros X Q HX. destruct HX as [Heq|Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right; apply H2; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_remove : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom) (V : qtyp),
  forall (y : atom) (b : binding),
  binds y b (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) -> y <> x -> binds y b (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  induction E1 as [|(z,c) E1 IH]; intros y b Hb Hne.
  - simpl in *. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + assumption.
  - simpl in *. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + left; assumption.
    + right; apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma env_subqua_extends_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom) (V : qtyp),
  wf_env (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) ->
  env_subqua_extends (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 x V Hwf. split.
  - intros X U HX.
    destruct (eq_dec X x) as [->|Hne].
    + exfalso. pose proof (wf_env_uniq _ Hwf) as Hu.
      assert (Hb1 : binds x (bind_sub U) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) by assumption.
      assert (Hb2 : binds x (bind_typ V) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)).
      { apply binds_app_3. apply binds_app_3. left; reflexivity. }
      pose proof (binds_unique _ _ _ _ Hb1 Hb2 Hu). discriminate.
    + apply binds_mid_remove with (x := x); assumption.

Lemma env_extends_dom : forall E E' (X : atom),
  env_extends E E' -> X `in` dom E -> X `in` dom E'.
Proof.
  intros E E' X Hext Hx. destruct (binds_In_inv binding X E Hx) as [b Hb].
  apply binds_In with (a := b). apply Hext. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma env_extends_dom_notin : forall E E' (X : atom),
  env_extends E E' -> X `notin` dom E' -> X `notin` dom E.
Proof.
  intros E E' X Hext Hx Hxe. apply Hx. apply env_extends_dom with (E := E); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma subqual_weaken : forall E Q R,
  subqual E Q R -> forall E', wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> subqual E' Q R.
Proof.
  intros E Q R H. induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hext'.
  - apply subqual_top; [exact Hwf' | apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption].
  - apply subqual_bot; [exact Hwf' | apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption].

  - apply subqual_join_inr.
    + apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
  - apply subqual_join_elim; [apply IHsubqual1|apply IHsubqual2]; assumption.
  - apply subqual_meet_eliml.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
    + apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption.
  - apply subqual_meet_elimr.
    + apply wf_qua_weaken with (E := E); assumption.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
  - apply subqual_meet_intro; [apply IHsubqual1|apply IHsubqual2]; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma subqtype_weaken : forall E S T,
  wf_env E -> subqtype E S T -> forall E', wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> subqtype E' S T.
Proof.

Definition env_subqua_extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  (forall (X : atom) (U : typ), binds X (bind_sub U) E -> binds X (bind_sub U) E') /\
  (forall (X : atom) (Q : qua), binds X (bind_qua Q) E -> binds X (bind_qua Q) E').

Lemma env_subqua_extends_cons : forall E E' (y : atom) (b : binding),
  env_subqua_extends E E' ->
  env_subqua_extends (y ~ b ++ E) (y ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' y b [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
  - intros X U HX. apply (binds_cons_1 binding X y (bind_sub U) b E) in HX. destruct HX as [[Heq Hbeq]|Hin].
    + subst X. subst b. unfold binds. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + unfold binds. simpl. right. apply H1; assumption.
  - intros X Q HX. apply (binds_cons_1 binding X y (bind_qua Q) b E) in HX. destruct HX as [[Heq Hbeq]|Hin].
    + subst X. subst b. unfold binds. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + unfold binds. simpl. right. apply H2; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_remove : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom) (V : qtyp)
  (y : atom) (b : binding),
  binds y b (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) -> y <> x -> binds y b (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| p E1 IH]; intros E2 x V y b Hb Hne.
  - simpl in Hb. apply (binds_cons_1 binding y x b (bind_typ V) E2) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq Hbeq]|Hin].
    + subst y. exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + assumption.
  - destruct p as [z c]. simpl in Hb.
    apply (binds_cons_1 binding y z b c (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq Hbeq]|Hin].
    + unfold binds. left. subst y. subst b. reflexivity.
    + unfold binds. right. apply (IH E2 x V y b); assumption.
Qed.


Lemma env_subqua_extends_mid : forall (E1 E2 : env) (x : atom) (V : qtyp),
  wf_env (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) ->
  env_subqua_extends (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) (E1 ++ E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 x V Hwf. split.
  - intros X U HX.
    destruct (eq_dec X x) as [->|Hne].
    + exfalso. pose proof (wf_env_uniq _ Hwf) as Hu.
      assert (Hb1 : binds x (bind_sub U) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) by assumption.
      assert (Hb2 : binds x (bind_typ V) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)).
      { apply binds_app_3. apply binds_app_2. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      pose proof (binds_unique binding x (bind_sub U) (bind_typ V) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) Hb1 Hb2 Hu). discriminate.
    + apply binds_mid_remove with (x := x) (V := V); assumption.
  - intros X Q HX.
    destruct (eq_dec X x) as [->|Hne].
    + exfalso. pose proof (wf_env_uniq _ Hwf) as Hu.
      assert (Hb1 : binds x (bind_qua Q) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)) by assumption.
      assert (Hb2 : binds x (bind_typ V) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2)).
      { apply binds_app_3. apply binds_app_2. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      pose proof (binds_unique binding x (bind_qua Q) (bind_typ V) (E1 ++ x ~ bind_typ V ++ E2) Hb1 Hb2 Hu). discriminate.
    + apply binds_mid_remove with (x := x) (V := V); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qua_subqua : forall E Q,
  wf_qua E Q -> forall E', env_subqua_extends E E' -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E Q H. induction H; intros E' Hext.
  - apply wf_qua_top.
  - destruct Hext as [H1 H2]. eapply wf_qua_fvar. apply H2. eassumption.
  - apply wf_qua_meet; [apply IHwf_qua1|apply IHwf_qua2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_qua_join; [apply IHwf_qua1|apply IHwf_qua2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_qua_bot.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subqua : forall E T,
  wf_typ E T -> forall E', wf_env E' -> env_subqua_extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H using wf_typ_mut_ind
    with (P := fun E T w => forall E', wf_env E' -> env_subqua_extends E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
         (P0 := fun E T w => forall E', wf_env E' -> env_subqua_extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_top.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_var with (U := U).
    destruct Hext as [H1 H2]. apply H1. assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_all with (L := union L (dom E')).
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + intros X Hx.
      assert (HxL : X `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hxd : X `notin` dom E') by fsetdec.
      assert (Hwt : wf_typ E' T1). { apply IHwf_typ; assumption. }
      apply (H0 X HxL (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      * apply wf_env_sub; [exact Hwf' | exact Hwt | exact Hxd].
      * apply env_subqua_extends_cons; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_qall with (L := union L (dom E')).
    + apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption.
    + intros X Hx.
      assert (HxL : X `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hxd : X `notin` dom E') by fsetdec.
      assert (Hwq : wf_qua E' T1). { apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption. }
      apply (H X HxL (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E')).
      * apply wf_env_qua; [exact Hwf' | exact Hwq | exact Hxd].
      * apply env_subqua_extends_cons; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_sum.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_typ_pair.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hext. apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
    + apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qtyp_subqua : forall E T,
  wf_qtyp E T -> forall E', wf_env E' -> env_subqua_extends E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H E' Hwf' Hext. destruct T as [Q T]. inversion H; subst.
  apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
  - eapply wf_qua_subqua; eassumption.
  - eapply wf_typ_subqua; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma subqual_subqua : forall E Q R,
  subqual E Q R -> forall E', wf_env E' -> env_subqua_extends E E' -> subqual E' Q R.
Proof.
  intros E Q R H. induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hext.
  - apply subqual_top; [exact Hwf' | apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption].
  - apply subqual_bot; [exact Hwf' | apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption].
  - apply subqual_refl_qvar; [exact Hwf' | apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption].
  - eapply subqual_trans_qvar; [| apply IHsubqual; assumption].
    destruct Hext as [H1 H2]. apply H2. assumption.
  - apply subqual_join_inl.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
    + apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption.
  - apply subqual_join_inr.
    + apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
  - apply subqual_join_elim; [apply IHsubqual1|apply IHsubqual2]; assumption.
  - apply subqual_meet_eliml.
    + apply IHsubqual; assumption.
    + apply wf_qua_subqua with (E := E); assumption.
  - apply subqual_meet_elimr.

Definition kind_of (b : binding) : nat :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub _ => 0
  | bind_typ _ => 1
  | bind_qua _ => 2
  end.

Definition env_kind_eq (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  (forall x b, binds x b E -> exists b', binds x b' E' /\ kind_of b' = kind_of b) /\
  (forall x b, binds x b E' -> exists b0, binds x b0 E /\ kind_of b0 = kind_of b).

Lemma env_kind_eq_cons : forall E E' x b b',
  env_kind_eq E E' -> kind_of b = kind_of b' ->
  env_kind_eq ((x,b) :: E) ((x,b') :: E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b b' [H1 H2] Kb. split.
  - intros y c Hyc. simpl in Hyc. destruct Hyc as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists b'. split; [left; reflexivity | symmetry; assumption].
    + destruct (H1 y c Hin) as [c' [Hin' Kc]].
      exists c'. split; [right; assumption | assumption].
  - intros y c Hyc. simpl in Hyc. destruct Hyc as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists b. split; [left; reflexivity | assumption].
    + destruct (H2 y c Hin) as [c' [Hin' Kc]].
      exists c'. split; [right; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

Lemma wf_qua_kind_eq : forall E Q,
  wf_qua E Q -> forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E Q H. induction H; intros E' Hk.
  - apply wf_qua_top.
  - destruct Hk as [H1 H2]. destruct (H1 X (bind_qua R) H) as [b' [Hb' Kb]].
    destruct b'; simpl in Kb; try discriminate.
    apply wf_qua_fvar with (R := q). exact Hb'.
  - apply wf_qua_meet; [apply IHwf_qua1 | apply IHwf_qua2]; exact Hk.
  - apply wf_qua_join; [apply IHwf_qua1 | apply IHwf_qua2]; exact Hk.
  - apply wf_qua_bot.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_kind_eq : forall E T,
  wf_typ E T -> forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H using wf_typ_mut_ind
    with (P := fun E T w => forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_typ E' T)
         (P0 := fun E T w => forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T).
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_top.
  - intros E' Hk.
    destruct Hk as [H1 H2]. destruct (H1 X (bind_sub U) b) as [b' [Hb' Kb]].
    destruct b'; simpl in Kb; try discriminate.
    apply wf_typ_var with (U := t). exact Hb'.
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + intros X Hx. apply (H0 X Hx (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      apply env_kind_eq_cons; [assumption | reflexivity].
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_qall with (L := L).
    + apply (wf_qua_kind_eq E T1 w E' Hk).
    + intros X Hx. apply (H X Hx (X ~ bind_qua T1 ++ E')).
      apply env_kind_eq_cons; [assumption | reflexivity].
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_sum.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_typ_pair.
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
    + apply IHwf_typ0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hk. apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
    + apply (wf_qua_kind_eq E Q w E' Hk).
    + apply IHwf_typ; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qtyp_kind_eq : forall E T,
  wf_qtyp E T -> forall E', env_kind_eq E E' -> wf_qtyp E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H E' Hk. destruct T as [Q T]. inversion H; subst.
  apply wf_qtyp_qtyp.
  - eapply wf_qua_kind_eq; [eassumption | exact Hk].
  - eapply wf_typ_kind_eq; [eassumption | exact Hk].
Qed.


Lemma env_kind_eq_refl : forall E, env_kind_eq E E.
Proof.
  intros E. split.
  - intros x b Hb. exists b. split; [assumption | reflexivity].
  - intros x b Hb. exists b. split; [assumption | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; simpl; eauto using uniq_nil, uniq_push.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall (x : atom) (b : binding) (E : env),
  wf_env ((x,b) :: E) ->
  wf_env E /\ x `notin` dom E /\
  (match b with
   | bind_sub T => wf_typ E T
   | bind_typ T => wf_qtyp E T
   | bind_qua Q => wf_qua E Q
   end).
Proof.
  intros x b E H. destruct b; simpl in *.
  - inversion H; subst. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion H; subst. repeat split; auto.
  - inversion H; subst. repeat split; auto.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Environment extension and weakening                                   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition env_extends (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall (x : atom) (b : binding), binds x b E -> binds x b E'.

Lemma env_extends_refl : forall E, env_extends E E.
Proof. intros E x b H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma env_extends_trans : forall E1 E2 E3,
  env_extends E1 E2 -> env_extends E2 E3 -> env_extends E1 E3.
Proof. intros E1 E2 E3 H12 H23 x b H. eauto. Qed.

Lemma env_extends_cons : forall E E' (x : atom) (b : binding),
  env_extends E E' -> env_extends ((x,b) :: E) ((x,b) :: E').
Proof.
  intros E E' x b H y c Hyc. simpl in *.
  destruct Hyc as [Heq|Hin].
  - left; assumption.
  - right; apply H; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma env_extends_insert : forall E1 E2 E3,
  env_extends E2 (E1 ++ E2 ++ E3).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 E3 x b H.
  apply binds_app_3.
  apply binds_app_2.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_qua_weaken : forall E E' Q,
  wf_env E' -> env_extends E E' -> wf_qua E Q -> wf_qua E' Q.
Proof.
  intros E E' Q Hwf Hext Hq.

  - apply wf_qua_join.
    + apply IH1. exact Hext.
    + apply IH2. exact Hext.
  - apply wf_qua_bot.
Qed.

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.FuncColour.LabelMap.

Require Export Fsub.FuncColour.Label.

Require Export Fsub.FqMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive qua : Set :=
  | qua_top : qua
  | qua_bvar : nat -> qua
  | qua_fvar : atom -> qua
  | qua_meet : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_join : qua -> qua -> qua
  | qua_bot : qua
.

Notation "`async" := qua_top.

Notation "`sync" := qua_bot.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_qall : qua -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_sum : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ
  | typ_ref : qtyp -> typ
with qtyp : Set :=
  | qtyp_qtyp : qua -> typ -> qtyp
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : qua -> qtyp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : qua -> typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_qabs : qua -> qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_qapp : exp -> qua -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inl : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_inr : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_case : exp -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_pair : qua -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_first : exp -> exp
  | exp_second : exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref_label : qua -> label -> exp
  | exp_deref : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_ref : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_upqual : qua -> exp -> exp
  | exp_check : qua -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Coercion qua_bvar : nat >-> qua.

Coercion qua_fvar : atom >-> qua.

Inductive concrete_qua : Set := cqua_top | cqua_bot.

Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
  match q with
  | qua_top => Some cqua_top
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => Some cqua_top
    | Some cqua_bot => (concretize Q2)
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => (concretize Q2)
    | Some cqua_bot => Some cqua_bot
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_bot => Some cqua_bot
  end.

Definition abstractize (s : concrete_qua) :=
  match s with
  | cqua_top => qua_top
  | cqua_bot => qua_bot
  end.

Inductive cqua_compatible : concrete_qua -> concrete_qua -> Prop :=
  | cqua_compatible_same : forall s, cqua_compatible s s
  | cqua_compatible_up : cqua_compatible cqua_bot cqua_top.

Notation "s ≤ t" := (cqua_compatible s t) (at level 70).

Fixpoint open_qq_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (Q : qua)  {struct Q} : qua :=
  match Q with
  | qua_top => qua_top
  | qua_bvar J => if (K == J) then R else (qua_bvar J)
  | qua_fvar X => qua_fvar X
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 => qua_meet (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 => qua_join (open_qq_rec K R Q1) (open_qq_rec K R Q2)
  | qua_bot => qua_bot
  end.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall Q (open_tqt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_tqt_rec K U T1) (open_tqt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_tqt_rec K U T1)
  end
with open_tqt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp Q (open_tt_rec K U T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_qt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_qt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T2)
  | typ_qall Q T => typ_qall (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qqt_rec (S K) R T)
  | typ_sum T1 T2 => typ_sum (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_pair T1 T2 => typ_pair (open_qqt_rec K R T1) (open_qqt_rec K R T2)
  | typ_ref T1 => typ_ref (open_qqt_rec K R T1)
  end
with open_qqt_rec (K : nat) (R : qua) (T : qtyp)  {struct T} : qtyp :=
  match T with
  | qtyp_qtyp Q T => qtyp_qtyp (open_qq_rec K R Q) (open_qt_rec K R T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P (open_tqt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (open_te_rec K U e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec (S K) U e2)

Notation "`sync" := qua_bot.

  | typ_pair : qtyp -> qtyp -> typ

.

Inductive exp : Set :=

Inductive concrete_qua : Set := cqua_top | cqua_bot.

Fixpoint concretize (q : qua) : (option concrete_qua) :=
  match q with
  | qua_top => Some cqua_top
  | qua_fvar X => None
  | qua_bvar n => None
  | qua_join Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => Some cqua_top
    | Some cqua_bot => (concretize Q2)
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_meet Q1 Q2 =>
    match (concretize Q1) with
    | Some cqua_top => (concretize Q2)
    | Some cqua_bot => Some cqua_bot
    | None => None
    end
  | qua_bot => Some cqua_bot
  end.

  match s with
  | cqua_top => qua_top
  | cqua_bot => qua_bot

  | cqua_compatible_same : forall s, cqua_compatible s s

Definition closed_exp (e : exp) : Prop :=
  forall (k : nat) (a : atom), open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar a) e = e.

Fixpoint close_ee_rec (k : nat) (xx : atom) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => if xx == y then exp_bvar k else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (close_ee_rec k xx e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (close_ee_rec k xx e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e2) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  end.

Lemma close_open_ee : forall (k : nat) (xx : atom) (e : exp),
  xx `notin` fv_ee e -> close_ee_rec k xx (open_ee_rec k xx e) = e.
Proof.
  intros k xx e. revert k. induction e; intros k H; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (k == n) as [Heq|Hneq]; simpl.
    + rewrite Heq. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (xx == a) as [Heq|Hneq]; [fsetdec | reflexivity].
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* tabs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* tapp *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* qabs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* qapp *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* let *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* inl *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* inr *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* case *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2, IHe3; auto.
  - (* pair *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* first *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* second *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* ref *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* deref *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* set_ref *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* upqual *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* check *) rewrite IHe; auto.
Qed.

Lemma close_open_comm : forall (e : exp) (i j : nat) (xx a : atom),

  close_ee_rec i xx (open_ee_rec j (exp_fvar a) e) =
  open_ee_rec j (exp_fvar a) (close_ee_rec i xx e).

  intros e. induction e; intros i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (j0 == n) as [Hj|Hj]; simpl.
    + destruct (xx == aa) as [Hxa|Hxa]; [exfalso; apply Hax; symmetry; exact Hxa | reflexivity].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (xx == a) as [Hxa|Hxa]; simpl.
    + destruct (j0 == i0) as [Hji|Hji]; [exfalso; apply Hij; symmetry; exact Hji | reflexivity].

    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =

                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))

    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e))
      by (apply (IHe (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* tapp *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))
      by (apply (IHe i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* qabs *) assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =

    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e2) =

  | exp_fvar y => if xx == y then exp_bvar k else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs P V e1 => exp_abs P V (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_tabs P V e1 => exp_tabs P V (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (close_ee_rec k xx e1) V
  | exp_qabs P Q e1 => exp_qabs P Q (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e1)
  | exp_qapp e1 Q => exp_qapp (close_ee_rec k xx e1) Q
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e2)
  | exp_inl P e1 => exp_inl P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_inr P e1 => exp_inr P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_case e1 e2 e3 =>
      exp_case (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e2) (close_ee_rec (S k) xx e3)
  | exp_pair P e1 e2 => exp_pair P (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_first e1 => exp_first (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_second e1 => exp_second (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_ref P e1 => exp_ref P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_ref_label P l => exp_ref_label P l
  | exp_deref e1 => exp_deref (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_set_ref e1 e2 => exp_set_ref (close_ee_rec k xx e1) (close_ee_rec k xx e2)
  | exp_upqual P e1 => exp_upqual P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  | exp_check P e1 => exp_check P (close_ee_rec k xx e1)
  end.

Lemma close_open_ee : forall (k : nat) (xx : atom) (e : exp),
  xx `notin` fv_ee e -> close_ee_rec k xx (open_ee_rec k xx e) = e.
Proof.
  intros k xx e. revert k. induction e; intros k H; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (k == n) as [Heq|Hneq]; simpl.
    + rewrite Heq. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (xx == a) as [Heq|Hneq]; [fsetdec | reflexivity].
  - (* abs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* app *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* tabs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* tapp *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* qabs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* qapp *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* let *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* inl *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* inr *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* case *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2, IHe3; auto.
  - (* pair *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* first *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* second *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* ref *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* deref *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* set_ref *) rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* upqual *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* check *) rewrite IHe; auto.
Qed.
Lemma S_neq : forall (i j : nat), i <> j -> S i <> S j.
Proof. intros i j H Hc. apply H. injection Hc. auto. Qed.

Lemma close_open_comm : forall (e : exp) (i j : nat) (xx a : atom),
  i <> j -> a <> xx ->
  close_ee_rec i xx (open_ee_rec j (exp_fvar a) e) =
  open_ee_rec j (exp_fvar a) (close_ee_rec i xx e).
Proof.
  intros e. induction e; intros i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (j0 == n) as [Hj|Hj]; simpl.
    + destruct (xx == aa) as [Hxa|Hxa]; [exfalso; apply Hax; symmetry; exact Hxa | reflexivity].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (xx == a) as [Hxa|Hxa]; simpl.
    + destruct (j0 == i0) as [Hji|Hji]; [exfalso; apply Hij; symmetry; exact Hji | reflexivity].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* abs *) assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e))
      by (apply (IHe (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* app *) assert (H1 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e1) =
                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))
      by (apply (IHe1 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e2) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e2))
      by (apply (IHe2 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - (* tabs *) assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e))
      by (apply (IHe (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* tapp *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))
      by (apply (IHe i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* qabs *) assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (He : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e))
      by (apply (IHe (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* qapp *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))
      by (apply (IHe i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* let *) assert (H1 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e1) =
                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))
      by (apply (IHe1 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e2) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e2))
      by (apply (IHe2 (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - (* inl *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))
      by (apply (IHe i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* inr *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))
      by (apply (IHe i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* case *) assert (H1 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e1) =
                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))
      by (apply (IHe1 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    assert (Hne : S i0 <> S j0) by (apply S_neq; exact Hij).
    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e2) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e2))
      by (apply (IHe2 (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    assert (H3 : close_ee_rec (S i0) xx (open_ee_rec (S j0) aa e3) =
                 open_ee_rec (S j0) aa (close_ee_rec (S i0) xx e3))
      by (apply (IHe3 (S i0) (S j0) xx aa Hne Hax)).
    rewrite H1, H2, H3. reflexivity.
  - (* pair *) assert (H1 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e1) =
                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))
      by (apply (IHe1 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e2) =

    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* set_ref *) assert (H1 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e1) =
                        open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e1))
      by (apply (IHe1 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    assert (H2 : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e2) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e2))
      by (apply (IHe2 i0 j0 xx aa Hij Hax)).
    rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - (* upqual *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =
                 open_ee_rec j0 aa (close_ee_rec i0 xx e))

    rewrite He. reflexivity.
  - (* check *) assert (He : close_ee_rec i0 xx (open_ee_rec j0 aa e) =

content.thinking:
Normally, this development likely has lemma `expr` derived from typing (`typing_expr` already proven). expr has no bvar case: expr only includes exp_fvar etc. So if typing implies expr, then closedness? expr's abs case only requires open_ee e1 x well-formed for some x, not no-bvar. Actually expr is free-variable well-formedness and open_ee e1 x means e1 has bvars up to binder depth but well-opened. expr does not preclude bvar at depths above binder opening? For expr (exp_abs P T e1), if e1 contains exp_bvar 5, then open_ee e1 x doesn't touch it, and expr could still hold? expr rules don't have a bvar case, so exp_bvar cannot be proven expr at all, but open_ee e1 x with exp_bvar 5 unterminated would fail expr. So expr e1 opened means all bvars in e1 are bound by enclosing binders and at depth 0. Thus expr e1 = locally closed. Typing implies expr (already proven `typing_expr`). So perhaps no separate typing_closed needed: we can use expr for closedness. But open_ee_rec with exp_fvar requires exactly locally closed; expr indeed means locally closed? For e1 under abs, expr e1 is not directly established, only expr (open_ee e1 x). But locally closed e1 can be recovered. This is essentially the same as closed_inv_open_ee but with expr instead of closed_exp under term opening.

Hmm. But we need term substitution commutation: the standard result in locally nameless metatheory: if expr e (locally closed), then open_ee e v is substitution. Rather than develop all this ourselves, maybe the library FqMeta / Metatheory provides lemmas! Let me inspect the exported Metatheory modules for existing open/close/fv lemmas, env substitution, and associated tactics. The original Fsub development has `Subst` / `Env` modules perhaps.
